segments.name: Specialty Chemicals
segments.description: Develops and manufactures specialty chemical formulations and intermediates for energy, HII, personal care, CASE, agriculture, water treatment and other industrial customers.
segments.evidence: The Company has one reportable segment: Specialty Chemicals.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay Ascent for specialty chemical products and custom manufacturing services, including formulation development, blending, packaging and related support.
revenueModel.evidence: Beyond its product portfolio, Ascent provides comprehensive custom manufacturing services spanning product development, process optimization, scale-up, and commercial production.

changes.text: In 2025, the Company sold substantially all assets of its BRISMET subsidiary, exiting that business.
changes.evidence: On April 4, 2025, the Company and Purchaser completed the transaction contemplated by the Purchase Agreement.
